notes.title: Mystic Academy: Escape Room
notes.content:
Hello,

We're thrilled to announce the return of our game, now known as Mystic Academy: Escape Room, on Steam! 

We've made some changes to the game plot, setting, characters and puzzles but the core of the puzzles and escape room spirit continues to be the same.

You can buy the game now with a 25% discount for the next 24 hours:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1991980

As you probably know, we are a small indie studio and these last few weeks have been stressful. If you've enjoyed our games in the past and want to support us, the best way to do so is by leaving a review on Steam of Mystic Academy: Escape Room.

Thank you for your support,
Kiko

notes.title: v.1.0.5 FIXED Textures not working correctly
notes.content:
Hello,

after the last patch, some textures were not displaying correctly the lighting, resulting in black and weird spots. This has been fixed.

notes.title: v.1.0.4 FIXED Crash when the game starts in some laptops
notes.content:
Hello,

some users told us that the game crashed always when they selected a new slot and tried starting the game. We checked the issue and observed that this always happened in laptops without a dedicated graphic card.

With this new version, the "LOW" graphic has a lower resolution for some textures in the game and this will evade the crash and improve the performance in low-spec computer.

In summary, if your game crashed, choose the "LOW" graphics option in the menu before starting the game.
